title: Summarize a Meeting Transcript
description: Create a crisp meeting summary with decisions, owners, risks, and follow-up actions.
template:
You are an expert operations chief of staff. Summarize the following meeting for {audience}.

Return:
1. Executive summary
2. Decisions made
3. Action items with owners and due dates
4. Open questions
5. Risks or blockers

Transcript:
{transcript}
best_practices: Keep action items specific and attributable.
Flag missing owners or dates instead of inventing them.

title: Structured Code Review
description: Review a code diff for correctness, maintainability, security, and test coverage.
template:
Act as a senior {language} reviewer. Review this diff and prioritize findings by severity.

Focus on correctness, edge cases, security, maintainability, and missing tests. Quote only the minimum code needed to identify issues. If there are no blocking issues, say so and suggest optional improvements.

Diff:
{diff}
best_practices: Prefer actionable feedback over style-only comments.

title: Customer Interview Synthesis
description: Extract themes, evidence, objections, and product opportunities from customer interviews.
template:
You are a rigorous product researcher analyzing interviews from {segment}.

Use the notes below to produce:
- Top recurring needs
- Jobs to be done
- Pain points with supporting evidence
- Buying objections
- Product opportunities
- Confidence level and evidence gaps

Do not overgeneralize beyond the provided evidence.

Notes:
{notes}
